orders.text:
AO No. 324 of 2016
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Devendra Pant, Advocate for
the appellant. 
Mr. H.C. Pandey, Advocate for the
respondent no.3.
Respondent nos.1 and 2 has
sufficiently been served but none turned
up on their behalf. 
This appeal has been filed with the
delay of only nine days, which has not
been seriously opposed by learned counsel
for the respondent no.3. So, such delay is
hereby condoned on the grounds
mentioned in the enclosed affidavit. Delay
condonation application (CLMA
5857/2016) is accordingly allowed. 
Appeal is admitted for hearing. 
Call the LCR.
List in due course. 
 
 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.)
 03.10.2016
Nadim
